thread:
maria_marketing: Quick kickoff — we need a short playbook for the website copy sprint that ties launch posts, benchmark narratives, and the webinar funnel together. Focus: Hosted API, Dedicated, Private pages. Goal: publish hero + 3 micro-CTAs by next Tue.

tia_copy: On it. I'll draft 3 hero variants (developer-first, economics-led, reliability-led). Which one do we want to push in launch posts?

alex_growth: Dev-first performs best in our tests for signups, but econ-led converts better for trial upgrades. Suggest we A/B hero on /hosted vs /dedicated.

sam_product: Agree. Also: webinar signups should map to product-lane — Hosted -> quickstart track, Dedicated -> enterprise proof track, Private -> compliance track. That routing kills friction.

maria_marketing: Nice. tia, quick ask — include a 1-line bench narrative we can use in a launch post (twitter + linkedin) and a 2-line preview for the webinar page. Keep them skimmable. :spiral_calendar:

tia_copy: Drafts incoming. Posting first pass: 
- Hero A (Dev-first): "Ship LLM features with predictable, production-grade inference."
- Hero B (Economics): "Slash per-token cost while keeping latency and quality predictable."
- Hero C (Trust): "Private, compliant inference where you control data and keys."

Bench narrative (single line): "Benchmarked: consistent <20ms p95 across mixed workloads on Dedicated; 3x cost reduction with caching/quantization on batch NLP jobs."

Webinar preview (two lines): "Hands-on: deploy with hosted APIs, scale with Dedicated, secure with Private. Live demos + benchmarking walkthroughs + customer Q&A."

alex_growth: That bench line is nice. Can we tighten numbers — p95 18-22ms range? "<25ms" feels generic.

tia_copy: Updated: "Benchmarked: p95 18–22ms for short-chat workloads on Dedicated; up to 3x unit cost savings using cache + quantization."

ben_engineering: FYI, the 18–22ms claim is for our current gen config (A100 equiv, batching disabled). If you mention caching quantization gains, please note workload variability in an aside on the marketing page.

maria_marketing: Good catch. Put a small parenthetical: "(measured on representative chat and summarization workloads; results vary with model/sequence length)" on the landing.

sam_product: For routing logic — can we add UTM param mapping rules? Eg /signup?lane=hosted -> assign trial_plan=starter, lane=dedicated -> sales outreach. We'll need the marketing funnel doc updated.

alex_growth: I'll add mapping to the growth playbook. Suggest: webinar registrants get a follow-up tailored to lane (send 3 emails: overview, benchmark deck, CTA to lane-specific trial or contact).

tia_copy: For launch posts: short templates
- Twitter: "Announcing Redwood Inference — predictable, high-performance LLM serving for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Join our webinar: <link> #inference #llm"
- LinkedIn: "Today we launch Redwood Inference — unified runtime for production LLMs across hosted, reserved, and private stacks. Read about benchmarks and join our webinar for a live demo: <link>"

maria_marketing: Love the tone. Can we add one line about rollouts: "canary rollouts + automatic fallbacks" for enterprise folks? Put that in the Dedicated paragraph on the landing.

tia_copy: Added: "Built for production: canary rollouts, A/B model variants, and automatic fallbacks to keep apps online."

ben_engineering: Quick note: "automatic fallbacks" need to be product-accurate — we fallback to compatible model variants or regions, not arbitrary models. Wording updated to "fallbacks to compatible variants/regions."

tia_copy: Done. New sentence: "...fallbacks to compatible model variants and regions."

maria_marketing: Actionable next steps:
1) Tia: finalize hero options + one-liners for each page (hosted/dedicated/private) — EOD today.
2) Alex: add UTM -> lane mapping in growth playbook + email sequences — EOD tomorrow.
3) Ben: confirm benchmark phrasing and short parenthetical caveat — EOD today.
4) Sam: wireframe webinar landing copy + routing rules with Prod — by Friday.

alex_growth: Will do. Adding task to Notion: https://www.notion.so/redwood/landing-copy-brief-abc123

maria_marketing: Cool. If anyone has objections to the hero candidates, shout now. Otherwise I'll schedule a 20m sync tomorrow to lock the hero and the launch post copy. :calendar:

ben_engineering: No objections. I'll post a short tech note in the thread with exact benchmark config (hardware, model family, batch sizes) so copy matches reality.

tia_copy: I'll prep 3 micro-CTA variants for each page (try, benchmarks, schedule a demo). Short copy only.

launchbot: Reminder: webinar event created for 2025-06-03 10:00 PDT — /events/rdw-infer-live — registrants -> marketing list.

maria_marketing: Perfect. Thanks team — wrapping this into the launch doc now.
